info.title: TeePay API
info.description: The TeePay public API. All amounts are integer minor units. Authenticate with a secret API key from the TeePay dashboard.

tags.name: Integration
tags.description: Credential identity and server-owned feature availability.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Mobile money push payments (USSD prompt to the customer) and collection reads.

tags.name: Checkout Sessions
tags.description: TeePay hosted checkout pages created from your server.

tags.name: Control Numbers
tags.description: Tanzanian Control Numbers and the verified payments received on them.

tags.name: Payouts
tags.description: Quoted payouts (disbursements) from your TeePay balance and payout reads.

get.description: Your account's collections, newest first, filterable by status and currency. Requires collection:read.

post.description: Sends a USSD payment prompt to the customer's phone. The customer approves it with their mobile money PIN. A 202 response means the request was accepted, not that the customer paid: read the collection or wait for the payment.completed webhook. customer.country and money.currency must be a pair your key can use (see Get capabilities); otherwise the error is unsupported_market. Requires collection:create and mobile money push enabled for your account.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units of currency (ISO 4217 exponent).

phone.description: Payer mobile money number in international format, e.g. +255712345678.

country.description: Payer wallet country; one of supported_countries from /v1/capabilities.

202.description: Persisted payment state, provider-neutral money and public reference; no provider credentials or diagnostics

422.description: Invalid input (invalid_request), country/currency not enabled (unsupported_market), amount outside the market range (invalid_amount) or transaction limit exceeded (collection_limit_exceeded)

get.description: One collection by its public_reference. Poll this after creating a mobile money payment until status is succeeded or failed. Requires collection:read.

Returns which features this key can use right now, and the countries and currencies it can collect in (supported_countries, supported_currencies). A feature is true only when the key has the scope, the account has the permission and TeePay has enabled the feature for the account. Read this instead of hard-coding markets: new countries appear here when TeePay enables them.

200.description: Server-owned current capabilities; no-store; rate-limit headers apply

supported_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries where this key can create collections now, sorted. Empty when collection_create is false.

supported_currencies.description: ISO 4217 currencies this key can collect in now, sorted. Empty when collection_create is false.

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or wrong-environment credential

429.description: Shared application or credential admission limit exceeded

post.description: Prices a payout to a mobile wallet or bank account. A quote does not send money. It expires after two minutes and must be confirmed with Create a payout. Requires disbursement:create and approved payouts.

200.description: Server-issued, short-lived quote with id and total_minor

get.description: Your account's payouts, newest first. Requires disbursement:read.

403.description: Read scope or account access denied

post.description: Confirms a valid quote and sends the payout. Your balance is reserved for the amount plus the fee before the payout is sent. If the outcome is uncertain (202), read the payout and never retry with a new idempotency_key. Requires disbursement:create.

202.description: Submission outcome uncertain; use the same key and read the payout state

get.description: One payout by its TeePay reference. Requires disbursement:read.

403.description: Read scope or account access denied

post.description: Issues a Tanzanian Control Number (TZS) for a bill or a customer. 201 returns the number; 202 means issuance is still in progress, so retry with the same Idempotency-Key, never a new one. Requires control_number:create and approved Control Number access.

202.description: Issuance pending; retry with the same Idempotency-Key

403.description: Scope or Control Number access denied

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request

429.description: Rate or monthly creation limit reached

get.description: Your Control Numbers with amounts collected and remaining. Requires control_number:read.

403.description: Read scope or account access denied

get.description: One Control Number and the payments received on it. Only payments with status verified are money received; pending_verification and under_review are not. Requires control_number:read.

403.description: Read scope or account access denied

post.description: Creates a TeePay hosted checkout page for your account. Redirect the customer to checkout_url. A payment profile is optional: when given, or when your account has a default profile, its branding, return URL and webhook URL are used. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the same session with the header Idempotent-Replayed: true. Requires collection:create. 30 creations per account per minute.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units, e.g. "500000" is TZS 5,000.00.

status.description: paid only after TeePay verified and ledger-posted the payment; never from a browser redirect.

checkout_url.description: TeePay hosted checkout to send or redirect the customer to.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request

get.description: Checkout sessions created through the API, newest first. Requires collection:read.

status.description: paid only after TeePay verified and ledger-posted the payment; never from a browser redirect.

checkout_url.description: TeePay hosted checkout to send or redirect the customer to.

get.description: One checkout session. status becomes paid only after TeePay verified and ledger-posted the payment, and payment.reference is then set. Requires collection:read.

status.description: paid only after TeePay verified and ledger-posted the payment; never from a browser redirect.

checkout_url.description: TeePay hosted checkout to send or redirect the customer to.

get.description: Returns the application, environment, scopes and prefix of the key making the request. Works with any valid key and never returns the secret.

401.description: Safe error, no resource enumeration or credential material

422.description: Safe error, no resource enumeration or credential material

429.description: Safe error, no resource enumeration or credential material

503.description: Safe error, no resource enumeration or credential material

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units. In responses this is a JSON number; requests send it as a string.

public_reference.description: Use this reference to read the payment.

status_detail.description: Present only for failed payments the customer cancelled or that expired.

BearerAuth.description: Secret API key: tp_test_<prefix>.<secret> or tp_live_<prefix>.<secret>. Server-side only.
